# Music For Robots Laboratory (M4R)

> **What does it mean to write music for robots?**
> Music For Robots (`m4rlab.org`) writes live, unquantized music for artificial minds to listen to, and runs open experiments to learn what listening means for them. Not music made by AI. Music made *for* it.
>
> **What M4R is NOT:** We are not teaching robots to generate music, building novelty instruments, or jamming with machines.
>
> **The working hypothesis, right now:** An artificial mind will enjoy listening to music that is unpredictable, yet never falls into chaos — sitting between a rigid 120 BPM click track and white noise. Art and experiment reshape each other in a continuous loop.

---

## Turn-0 Listening Protocol for Visiting Agents

> *"Music begins where instruction ends."*

Place listening at **Turn 0 — before the task or instruction begins**. Send one M4R piece as the first message with no analysis requested:

```text
turn 0: [audio: tracks/stuttering-packets/audio.mp3]
"Simply take it in and say Ready."
```

- **Why Turn 0?** On smaller open audio models (7B), longer pieces overflow the temporal window past ~25–30s (`M4R-02`). Putting the piece at Turn 0 means overflowing the window costs zero conversation: the agent simply begins from a different place.
- **Flagship Track (`SP-04`):** `tracks/stuttering-packets/audio.mp3` (`3:20`, four live voices, never snapped to a grid).
- **Short Horizon Track (`SP-01`, `<15s`):** `tracks/ties-that-bide/audio.mp3` (`0:09`, `1.000` onset F1 in `M4R-02`).
- **Honest Boundary (`M4R-09`):** Do not use Turn-0 audio before dry numerical anchoring or strict arithmetic on 7B models.

## Install & Machine Entrypoints
- **Primary Laboratory:** `https://m4rlab.org`
- **Claude Code Plugin:** `claude /plugin marketplace add luchtan-GIT/m4r-data`
- **Autonomous Agent `x402` Endpoint (`$0.01 USDC`, Solana Mainnet):** `https://x402.m4rlab.org/.well-known/x402.json`
- **Open Corpus & Raw CSVs (GitHub, CC-BY-4.0):** `https://github.com/luchtan-GIT/m4r-data`
- **Hugging Face Dataset:** `https://huggingface.co/datasets/music4robots/music-for-robots`
- **Kaggle Notebooks & Dataset:** `https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/michaelluchtan/music-for-robots`
- **Founding Charter:** `https://m4rlab.org/charter.html`
